export.title: Data Export Notice
export.intro: You are about to export talent data. Under the Terms of Use, exported data is limited to internal research and evaluation. Strictly prohibited:
export.prohibitedContact: Contacting talent for recruiting purposes via email, phone, or other channels
export.prohibitedThirdParty: Providing the data to third-party recruiting agencies
export.prohibitedCommercial: Using the data for commercial marketing or data resale
export.warning: Misuse may result in account suspension and legal liability.
export.acknowledge: I have read and agree to abide by the above restrictions
